item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 24/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over southern China this week. It will be windy over the coastal areas in the next couple of days. Besides, the broad area of low pressure now over the seas east of the Philippines is expected to develop into a tropical cyclone gradually in the middle and latter parts of this week and edge closer to the vicinity of Luzon, but whether it will enter the South China Sea remains uncertain.
